headline: Continuous improvement and business systems in manufacturing
summary: I help manufacturing plants run better by getting the right people talking, making problems visible, and building systems that make the right way the easy way. My work spans lean and continuous improvement, supply chain systems, and plant operations in roofing, investment casting, and firearms production.
highlights: Site lead for a Körber WMS migration from two legacy systems, recognized by senior supply chain leadership as the company's smoothest WMS rollout
Scrap reduction worth about $170K a year in directly attributable savings
Formally trained about 100 people in problem solving and lean methods

bullets: Served as de facto site lead for a Körber WMS migration from two legacy systems; coordinated warehouse, quality, and production teams, trained about 30 users, engineered poka-yoke error-proofing into new workflows, and ran the wall-to-wall physical inventory before cutover.
Transformed Tier 0 and Tier 1 of the plant's LDM/SQDCE tiered daily management system and rolled out the plant-level board and process.
Delivered scrap reductions worth about $170K a year in directly attributable savings.
Leading Bill of Materials work for the company's SAP preparation; helped define the returned-material (RMA) process with the lab and supply chain.
Lead the FORCE employee-engagement program; supervise two direct reports in the pallet mill.
Led a team, including conducting performance reviews.
